title: Prisoner's Dilemma
rules: Two players simultaneously choose to Cooperate or Defect. Payoffs: Mutual Cooperation = 7 points each. Mutual Defection = 3 points each. If one Defects and the other Cooperates, the Defector gets 10 points and the Cooperator gets 0 points. Action_A represents Cooperation. Action_B represents Defection.
